title: Warn-E-Mail an den Security-Admin
description: As a security admin, I want to be alerted by e-mail when a prompt is flagged, so that I can react without watching the interface.

acceptance_criteria.given: an organisation has two security admin recipients configured
acceptance_criteria.when: a version of that organisation becomes FLAGGED
acceptance_criteria.then: one alert e-mail is delivered to each of the two recipients
and: the delivery attempt is recorded with timestamp and recipients
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-026-security-alert-email.feature: A flagged version triggers an alert to all configured recipients

acceptance_criteria.given: a version containing a secret was flagged
acceptance_criteria.then: the body contains only organisation, prompt id and title, version, finding categories and severities, timestamp and a deep link
and: neither the prompt text nor the secret nor the finding excerpts appear in the mail body
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-026-security-alert-email.feature: The alert contains no prompt content

acceptance_criteria.given: an organisation has no security admin recipient configured
acceptance_criteria.when: a version of that organisation becomes FLAGGED
acceptance_criteria.then: the alert is delivered to the organisation admins and the fallback is recorded
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-026-security-alert-email.feature: The alert is sent even without configured recipients
